name: Archipelago
source:
Candice is a troubled feline, looking to escape from their struggles.

Now headed on holiday to the picturesque island of Naxos, will they finally find the answers they’re looking for?

Archipelago provides a perspective on sensitive themes around self-worth, solitude and new beginnings.

[From [url=https://dereli-ceraje.itch.io/archipelago]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
坎迪斯是一只陷入困境的猫科动物，想要摆脱困境。

现在前往风景如画的纳克索斯岛度假，他们最终能找到他们想要的答案吗？

《群岛》提供了一个关于自我价值、孤独和新开始等敏感主题的视角。

[来自[url=https://dereli-ceraje.itch.io/archipelago]Itch.io[/url]]
